requests.subject: 30 ml cylindrical serum bottle + dropper closure — technical specification request
requests.body:
Hello,

We are specifying packaging for a 30 ml cylindrical frosted-glass cosmetic serum bottle with a metallic dropper closure, and we need manufacturer specification data rather than marketing copy.

Could you send, for one exact product variant:

  - exact 30 ml bottle SKU
  - dimensional drawing
  - bottle diameter
  - bottle height without closure
  - neck finish
  - neck diameter
  - overflow capacity
  - glass weight
  - compatible dropper SKU
  - closure drawing
  - collar diameter
  - collar height
  - bulb/outer-cover construction
  - pipette length
  - total assembled height
  - materials
  - decoration methods
  - CAD/PDF files
  - MOQ and sample availability

A dimensional drawing or CAD file is the single most useful item. Please also confirm whether the visible dark component on your dropper closures is an exposed elastomer bulb, a bulb with an integral flared skirt, or a separate decorative outer cover, since that affects our design.

Thank you.
